caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object with a symmetrical geometric design, appearing to be a decorative or functional plate. The central portion is a large, irregularly shaped square with rounded indents on four sides, each edge closely bordered by small black rivets or studs. Radiating outward from the square’s four sides are four triangular sections, each also bordered and dotted with rivets, with the upper and lower triangles larger than the side ones. Within the square, there is a large circular pattern formed by two closely spaced concentric rings of rivets, containing a smaller central circle with four radial lines each ending in a rivet. At the bottom of the square, attached to the lower triangle, is a cylindrical, cup-like structure with a scalloped rim, rendered with a darker shading and accompanied by a flat, straight piece extending from its right. The colors in the drawing are primarily shades of gray, black, and muted blue, which give a metallic appearance, set against a plain off-white background. In the bottom-right corner, the artist's name “I.M. BURGO” is written in small black letters.
title: Cut Tin Candle Holder
